heroHeadline: Zaidi Cabinet Partial, KRG Budget Frozen, PMF Crisis Deepens as Iraq Enters New Government's Third Week
heroSubtitle: Ali al-Zaidi was sworn in as Iraq's youngest PM (age 40) on May 16 after parliament approved 14 of 23 ministers on May 14, leaving defense, interior, and 7 other portfolios vacant pending Eid al-Adha negotiations. The KRG signed $110B US gas deals on May 19 triggering Baghdad's suspension of Kurdistan's May budget transfer — leaving 1.2 million Kurdish public employees facing a salary crisis. A US-charged Kata'ib Hezbollah commander is accused of plotting a New York synagogue bombing. Iraq's oil output remains ~1.5M bpd (66% below pre-Hormuz crisis levels), with full recovery not expected until late 2026.
